source.title: Selective JAK2 inhibition by TG101209 reprograms macrophage polarization and alleviates acute lung injury
source.saved_metadata_status: epublish; no commentCorrectionList or versionList returned in inspected exact-source metadata. This is not a universal absence-of-notices guarantee.

verdict: Refine the existing TG101209 appraisal to retain an early post-LPS noncancer lung-protection comparison, alongside the separate unresolved BUB1B thermal-probe role. Native respiratory positives are limited to two of six TG treatment contrasts; survival statistics, formulation, mechanism and exposure limit translation. No BUB1B restoration, MVA or muscle benefit was measured here.

compound.catalog_lot_purity_salt: Not reported in the inspected main/supplement. Figure7 includes a nominal chemical structure but does not authenticate an administered batch or salt.
compound.vehicle: Not reported for TG101209 in mouse or cell experiments. Do not infer PBS/saline or DMSO as the drug formulation.
compound.identity_separation: TG101209 is retained as that named reagent; no equivalence to TG101348/fedratinib, approved product, ordinary supplement or clinical exposure is established.

exposures.model: Male C57BL/6 mice,6-7 weeks,SPF; no BUB1B lesion
exposures.challenge: E. coli O55:B5 LPS 2 mg/kg intratracheally in 50 µL sterile PBS
exposures.drug: TG101209 40 mg/kg intratracheally 2 h after saline/LPS
exposures.control: Saline control,LPS-only,TG-only,and LPS+dexamethasone 5 mg/kg intratracheally at the corresponding 2 h time point
exposures.timing_class: Early post-challenge intervention, not prophylactic pretreatment; no pre-dose proof of established functional injury or delayed-repair arm. No repeat-dose schedule is stated.
exposures.endpoints: 72 h tissue/BALF/respiratory measurements; distinct survival cohort followed every 24 h for 7 days
exposures.n: 5 mice/group for bars and72 h experiments;7 mice/group for separate survival curves per Figure1 caption

exposures.challenge: LPS 50 ng/mL for 24 h with or without TG101209
exposures.drug: 1 µM selected for mechanistic experiments; exact sequential addition/washout is not described
exposures.control: Untreated,LPS-only,TG-only,LPS+TG; no DXM culture arm in displayed experiments
exposures.n: 3 independent replicates/group as reported, not three independent animal cohorts
exposures.scope: Concurrent in-vitro treatment, macrophage markers/cytokines/phosphorylation; no primary normal human lung or muscle function

vascular_edema_histology.positive: TG+LPS reduces Evans-blue extravasation(***), wet/dry ratio(**), and blinded lung-injury score(*) versus LPS; representative histology is consistent with less injury.
vascular_edema_histology.limit: Values and raw individual observations were not digitized; no formal normal-control equivalence or universal tissue restoration claimed.

BALF_cell_counts.limit: Native brackets qualify the prose claiming reduction of all inflammatory cell categories.

survival.count_interpretation: Curve step/end levels are consistent with7/7,6/7,1/7,5/7,4/7 respectively, using caption n=7. These are transparent visual/count inferences, not recovered event records or numerical digitization.
survival.statistical_limit: Author calls survival benefit significant and superior to DXM, but no displayed curve test/P or specified survival statistical method validates that superiority here.
survival.drug_only_death: One death is suggested by TG-only curve; no causal attribution, necropsy or cause-specific record supplied.

macrophage_molecular.lung: iNOS/CD80,CD163/Arg1 RNA/protein/IF and flow-cytometric macrophage subset measurements support treatment-associated anti-inflammatory shifts; panel-specific nulls remain in source_issues.
macrophage_molecular.culture: CD80/CD163 protein contrasts, displayed Cd80/Nos2/Cd163/Arg1 qPCR and TNFα/IL6/IL10 contrasts retain positives. iNOS and Arg1 protein treatment contrasts are ns.
macrophage_molecular.function_limit: Marker-defined fractions are not fate mapping, lineage conversion, pathogen clearance or macrophage functional rescue.

pathway.in_vitro: p-JAK2/JAK2 and p-STAT3Tyr705/STAT3 treatment contrasts positive(**); p-STAT3Ser727/STAT3 is ns. IF is representative localization/intensity evidence, without independent quantitative translocation test.
pathway.lung: All three displayed phosphorylation-ratio treatment contrasts are positive: JAK2*,Ser727****,Tyr705*.
pathway.causality: No JAK2/STAT3 genetic perturbation, orthogonal target-specific rescue, resistant mutant, macrophage depletion or lineage-specific necessity test is reported. Associations support a pathway-linked interpretation rather than demonstrated exclusive mediation.

nulls_and_harms.CCK8: FigureS3 shows no marked drop at displayed 0.1562-5 µM after 24 h; 10 and 20 µM markedly reduce CCK-8 signal(****versus untreated). This is a metabolic viability proxy, not broad normal-cell safety or a clinical therapeutic window.
nulls_and_harms.histology: S2 provides representative heart,liver,spleen,kidney images; no quantitative organ-toxicity scores, chemistry, body-weight trajectory or chronic follow-up are provided. Its caption additionally lists lung although the displayed four organ columns do not.
nulls_and_harms.survival: TG-only death retained; cause unknown. Separate short-term organ histology cannot negate it.

allocation_statistics.randomization: Methods explicitly states random assignment to five mouse groups; sequence/allocation-concealment details not given.
allocation_statistics.blinding: Two blinded pathologists independently scored lung sections. Blinding of drug administration, respiratory measurement, other assays or survival assessment is not reported.
allocation_statistics.biological_unit: Mouse for in-vivo bar endpoints; separate mice for survival. Culture n=3 described as independent replicates; no subfield/cell count treated as additional biological n.
allocation_statistics.limits: No prespecified primary endpoint, sample-size justification, family-wide correction across the many endpoints, raw respiratory/event records, or specific survival test is supplied in the inspected main/supplement. No new P values were calculated.

BUB1B_scope.RNA: No BUB1B/Bub1b RNA assay in complete inspected scientific main/captions/supplement; TableS1 lists 10 other genes.
BUB1B_scope.protein: No BubR1/BUB1B protein, localization, stabilization or thermal assay in this source.
BUB1B_scope.function: No checkpoint, chromosome-count/segregation, faithful daughter-cell production, muscle-force or BUB1B-mutant/MVA assay.
BUB1B_scope.boundary: Finite absence claim scoped to this main, seven native figures and four-page supplement; not an all-literature protein null.

previous_evidence_preserved.context: Existing primary-abstract/ChEMBL thermal-probe limits and competing JAK2/FLT3/RET pharmacology remain unchanged. This new source cannot validate the unheated-abundance or turnover inference from the earlier assay.

source_issues.finding: Prose broadly describes impaired and reversed respiratory parameters. Native TG+LPS-versus-LPS labels support tidal volume and FEV100/FVC positives, while minute volume, peak expiratory flow, FEV100 and lung resistance are ns. LPS-versus-control peak flow and FEV100 are themselves ns.
source_issues.interpretation: Retain two positive published respiratory readouts and four null treatment comparisons; not restoration of every respiratory measure.

source_issues.finding: The only described acquisition is Buxco whole-body plethysmography with chamber pressure transducer; the report also lists FEV100/FVC and lung resistance without forced-maneuver, calibration or derivation details.
source_issues.interpretation: Published functional readouts with an unresolved measurement-validation gap, not evidence that the results are necessarily invalid.

source_issues.finding: Native curves favor TG+LPS over LPS, and descriptively over DXM+LPS. No curve P value, log-rank/Cox method or specific between-treatment significance is displayed; Methods specifies ANOVA/Tukey generally. TG-only curve also falls below 100%.
source_issues.interpretation: Do not claim statistically validated superiority to dexamethasone or blanket safety. Preserve the favorable curve direction and the drug-only death; cause is unknown.

source_issues.finding: Methods dries at45 °C until stable; caption says60 °C for 48 h.
source_issues.interpretation: Unresolved protocol discrepancy; retain the reported lower wet/dry outcome without silently choosing one protocol.

source_issues.finding: TG+LPS lymphocyte comparison is ns; baseline LPS effect on lung Arg1 protein and flow-cytometric M2 fraction is ns; cultured-cell iNOS/Arg1 protein treatment contrasts and STAT3Ser727 phosphorylation contrast are ns.
source_issues.interpretation: Do not convert the broader prose into all-marker or both-site significance. Other molecular/flow contrasts retain their reported positives.

source_issues.finding: Figure3 caption identifies B=CD80,C=iNOS while native axes give B=iNOS,C=CD80. Figure5 caption lists F=Arg1,G=Cd80,H=Cd163,I=Nos2 while native axes give F=Cd80,G=Nos2,H=Cd163,I=Arg1.
source_issues.interpretation: Use native labeled panels and preserve the discrepancy; no claim of image manipulation.

source_issues.finding: Methods lists CD80-FITC,F4/80-APC,CD206-PerCP-Cy5.5; native axes instead label CD80-BV421,F4/80-AF647,CD206-PE.
source_issues.interpretation: Exact fluorophore/acquisition documentation is inconsistent; full gating/raw files absent. Positive reported subset shifts do not establish cell-lineage conversion.

source_issues.finding: Discussion describes JAK2/STAT3 as inhibitory to M1 and driving M2 in a sentence citing prior work, whereas this study attributes its TG-inhibition effect to less M1/more M2.
source_issues.interpretation: Do not use this internally discordant sentence to establish pathway direction or necessity.
